articles.title: Modernizing Russia's armed forces, fuel situation — Putin's remarks
articles.summary: Putin stated at a People's Front forum that Russia's strength lies in its ability to overcome difficulties, emphasizing that Russia is modernizing its armed forces and achieving new results in the defense industry despite fuel derivative problems caused by Ukrainian actions.

articles.title: Putin discusses info threats posed by emerging technologies with Security Council
articles.summary: Putin held a meeting with permanent members of the Russian Security Council to discuss threats to Russia's information security stemming from the development and deployment of emerging technologies.

articles.title: Key statements from President Putin's meeting with Cabinet on fuel situation
articles.summary: Putin held a meeting with the cabinet on the operation of the fuel and transport sectors, instructing officials to fast-track fuel supply decisions to Crimea and stating that Russia's fuel difficulties are temporary with high sector margins of safety.

articles.title: Putin notes formation of partnerships by Russian Export Center with friendly states
articles.summary: Putin met with Russian Export Center Director General Veronika Nikishina and noted the successful establishment of sustainable partnerships with friendly countries, aimed at achieving a two-thirds increase in exports by 2030.

articles.title: Russia living through crucial time — Putin
articles.summary: Putin stated at a United Russia party congress that Russia is living through a crucial time and pledged to bring the Russian economy to a new technological level across all key spheres while ensuring national security.
